title: 1.4 Traversal and impact query at model and column level

Physical tables are junctions: a source is downstream of the models/seeds/snapshots that build its table, so jaffle seeds reach marts through their sources (F09); Airflow tasks that run a node are downstream of it. Impact follows derives edges where a model's column lineage is resolved/partial, falls back to model level marked inferred where it is unknown or not computed (with the reason), and reaches exposures and tasks that use the whole node; confidence is the strongest path's weakest evidence; unknowns on targets and impacted nodes (and their columns) are listed. A column_lineage callback lets callers compute lineage on demand. 5,000 models: model impact from the worst source (651 nodes) 3-5 ms; all columns of it 16-25 ms. Python 3.10 GC pauses of 200-285 ms vanish with gc.freeze() after load; noted in design 11 and LP-243.1.

title: Server unit tests hang on Windows CI (lineagepilot-lsp workflow)
description: On windows-latest the lineagepilot-lsp workflow hangs in the unit-test half (tests/test_indexing_units.py, test_context_locate.py, test_features_units.py, test_protocol.py) and GitHub does not stop it at the step or job time limit, so no log is kept (runs 41452565609, 41457246523, 41464814659, 41466771047, 41468735641, 41470571704 on 2 Nov 2026). The end-to-end tests pass on Windows in the lineagepilot-extension workflow, against the VSIX's bundled server on setup-python's interpreter. Leads: (1) tests start children with sys.executable, which in a uv venv on Windows is a launcher; killing it leaves the real interpreter running with the pipes open, and asyncio's IocpProactor.close() waits for pending pipe reads; (2) test_relative_to_follows_the_platform_case_rules patches os.path.normcase, which is ntpath on Windows. Windows was taken out of the workflow's matrix until this is fixed; reproduce on a Windows machine with pytest -v -x on each file.
notes: Lead from LP-qy0 (9 Nov 2026): a Windows-only shutdown hang in the E2E tests was a cancelled task whose finally deleted a file a thread still had open; Windows refused (PermissionError), the error escaped AirflowScanner.stop(), and the server never finished shutting down, so pytest-lsp's client.stop() waited forever.
